newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-WALES RECALL PAY REBEL QUINNELL.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WALES RECALL PAY REBEL QUINNELL.

text.p: Wales have recalled pay rebel Scott Quinnell for their match against the United States at Cardiff Arms Park on Janauary 11.
The Richmond back row forward recently settled his cash dispute with Welsh rugby chiefs, helped by a 10,000 pounds ($17,000) sponsorship boost from a Welsh businessman.
Quinnell, last capped against Western Samoa in 1994 before joining Wigan rugby league club, had made himself unavailable to coach Kevin Bowring.

He felt a 30,000 pounds ($51,000) retainer available to Wales-based internationals was too great, compared with the 10,000 pounds offered by Welsh Rugby Union bosses to squad members with English teams.
The businessman's cash has helped to bridge that gap and Quinnell subsequently became available after ruling himself out of pre-Christmas tests against France, Italy, Australia and South Africa.
Said Quinnell: "My main goal has always been to play for Wales once more and I look forward to playing my part in helping my country re-establish itself as a major international force."

Team: Neil Jenkins (Pontypridd); Ieuan Evans, Allen Bateman, Scott Gibbs (Swansea), Gareth Thomas; Arwel Thomas, Rob Howley; Chris Loader, Jonathan Humphreys (captain), David Young, Gareth Llewellyn, Mark Rowley, Steve Williams, Colin Charvis, Scott Quinnell.
